test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Choose the word that means the same as the given word.**

Arrogance
solution: The correct answer is: **Dominance** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • '**Arrogance**' means having an exaggerated sense of one's own importance or abilities. (किसी के स्वयं के महत्व या क्षमताओं की अतिरंजित भावना होना) • **For example-** *The CEO's arrogance was evident in the way he spoke to his employees, showing a lack of respect for their opinions and ideas.* • Marked option '**Dominance**' means having power and influence over others. (दूसरों पर शक्ति और प्रभाव रखना) • **For example-** *The company's dominance in the market was due to its innovative products and strategic partnerships.* • So, it is clear that '**Arrogance**' and '**Dominance**' both imply a sense of superiority, but dominance is more about having control and authority. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Option 1: **Inhibition **means a feeling of self-consciousness or restraint in a social situation. (किसी सामाजिक स्थिति में आत्म-चेतना या संयम की भावना) • Option 2: **Bashful **means shy or easily embarrassed. (शर्मीला या आसानी से शर्मिंदा होना) • Option 4: **Diffidence **means a lack of confidence or self-assurance. (आत्मविश्वास या आत्म-आश्वासन की कमी) 1a2:T889, The correct answer is: '**wrote the foreword**.'
